answer: Because the prism burn is logged at the bridge settlement, the nebula audit publishes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 54% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 292 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
